data.name: Sreeleela
data.gender_notes: Sreeleela is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sreeleela is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Sree’ which means wealth or goddess and ‘Leela’ which means play or music. It is the name of the goddess Lakshmi who is often depicted playing the Veena. This name symbolizes the divine play of the goddess and her connection to music and art. The name Sreeleela carries the meaning “Goddess of Music” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Telugu, Malayalam. Parents who choose Sreeleela usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of music and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sreeleela is a name that represents the divine play of the goddess Lakshmi. It signifies creativity, beauty, and artistry. It is a name that inspires one to connect with the divine and find joy and meaning in the world around them.
data.etymology: Sreeleela belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Music.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sreeleela total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
